'''BB-17-J''' was a green, hovering [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] that worked in the hangar bay of [[Sise Fromm's stronghold]]. It had one large lifting claw and a weapon mounted on top of its body. When infiltrating the facility, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] directed the droid to be careful with two cargo containers [[Kea Moll]] and [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] were hidden inside of.
